name: cloudflare-publish
description: Publish local HTTP or pinned SSH services from your Mac through your own Cloudflare Tunnel and Access.

interface.longDescription: Give a running local web app, private API, authenticated callback, or pinned machine-only SSH server a stable hostname through your own Cloudflare account. Plan and manage exact-hostname publications, Access audiences, verification, token rotation, and tunnel recovery. SSH requires client-side cloudflared and your own SSH credentials. Requires a local macOS executor, a separately installed cloudflare-publish CLI and cloudflared, and your own active full DNS zone and API token. This skill-only plugin does not install services or publish anything automatically. Removing it does not stop existing publications or retire their resources.
defaultPrompt: Use Cloudflare Publish to plan a protected hostname for my local web app.
Use Cloudflare Publish to inspect my tunnel manager and explain the next safe action.
